summary: Elbit Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release and an unofficial English translation of a rating report from S&P Global Ratings Maalot Ltd. The rating agency raised Elbit's long-term rating to ilAAA (local scale) with a stable outlook and reaffirmed its short-term rating of ilA-1+, citing improved financial ratios, strong operating performance, and a record-high backlog driven by geopolitical escalation and rising defense budgets. This is a routine credit rating update, not a special situation. The filing does not relate to any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or other transformative event. No deal terms, premium, or structural changes are present.
